[[Sealed in Fire]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Sealed in Fire]]:''' This weapon burns with a sealed power. It can have its power unsealed at the Ritual Table, adding one effect. Attempting to add another will remove the original.

Effect options: [[Legendary Affirmation]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Affirmation]]:''' Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to grant you 1,000 Temporary HP. • [[Legendary Ash]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Ash]]:''' Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to reduce enemy Magical Resistance Rating and Universal Spell Power. • [[Legendary Dust]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Dust]]:''' Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to reduce enemy Physical Resistance Rating and Positive Healing Amplification. • [[Legendary Ooze]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Ooze]]:''' Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to reduce enemy Physical and Magical Resistance Rating and summon oozes to your aid.
''(Note: Exactly which sort of ooze is summoned depends on what item this enchantment is found on.)'' • [[Legendary Salt]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Salt]]:''' Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to significantly slow your enemies. • [[Legendary Vacuum]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Vacuum]]:''' Your Attacks and offensive spells have a chance to inflict multiple stacks of [[Vulnerable]].
